Board (mitcad#2226): the FEFCO 0427 folder of 4 mm corrugated polypropylene (crease deduction 0.4, crease radius 0.5: each crease develops 8.6), inside 160 x 90 x 60: its rules F1, blank (sketch F2), creases (sketch F3), Face F4 and Folds F5 to F22. A script of its own beside sheet_board_0427 (mitcad#2495): each box's eighteen Folds take minutes to build, and the round trip builds each box twice.
